title: Checking your ex's profile is not closure.
old_caption:
Still checking your ex's profile at 2 AM?
One more scroll is the opposite of closure. Mute it, and open your life back up.

title: Your city doesn't decide your love life. You do.
old_caption:
Think your city is why your love life is stuck?
Love happens wherever people are brave and kind. Your city, your story.

title: Your first fight can be good news.
old_caption:
Just had your first fight and think it is over?
Taurus says a fight you repair together can make you stronger.

title: Houston food beats Austin food.
old_caption:
Houston food or Austin food: who actually wins?
The stars rule the real winner is sharing one plate with someone you like.

title: Your friends' opinion matters.
old_caption:
Do your friends get a say in who you date?
They love you, so hear them out. Then the choice is yours.

title: Geminis aren't two-faced. They're two-hearted.
old_caption:
Ever felt two things about someone at the same time?
Gemini says that is not fake. Mixed feelings are just human.

title: Ghosting is never the chill option.
old_caption:
Planning to just fade away from a match?
One kind "not for me" text is enough. Two lines, kind ones.

title: Couples don't need the same hobbies.
old_caption:
Do you and your partner love totally different things?
You do not need matching hobbies. Swap for a day and stay on the same team.

title: Houston is the best dating city in Texas.
old_caption:
Which city is best for dating? Three stars argue it out.
The verdict: the best city is the one where you actually show up.

title: Houston humidity is a test of true love.
old_caption:
Would your date still hold your hand in August heat?
Cancer is melting, but the hand-holding never stops. That is a keeper.
